items.summary: Approve containment-only execution. Continue existing reconciliation, failure-containment, measurement, bounded security-evidence, and private-launch workstreams. Do not create proposals, change requests, experiments, telemetry requests, spend, requeues, deployments, permission changes, credential changes, configuration changes, or external outreach. Preserve unavailable revenue, attribution, ROI, margin, causal lift, cost-to-learn, budget, and operational fields as unknown.

Continue failure containment without requeue. For each retained failure, document canonical lineage, deduplication identity, owner, root cause, smallest isolated repair, focused validation, rollback, queue eligibility, and explicit requeue-or-close disposition.

Keep the gated product private. Continue the existing read-only rights, data-flow, retention, consent, vendor, incident, accuracy, and measurement evidence work; keep the permission request unsent pending owner and human-counsel authorization.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture from authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Keep access, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, TLS, and disclosure controls unknown where unevidenced; retain private launch gates and make no production or permission changes.

Continue scheduled measurement using existing source-dated impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, site-attributed commission, and available AI cost only. Do not add instrumentation or request duplicate telemetry; preserve missing financial and operational fields as unknown.

No new queue work is technically ready. Existing queue capacity is consumed by active, measuring, failed-repair, reconciliation, and evidence work; proposed platform capabilities and research opportunities lack an approved implementation specification, isolated validation environment, owner, and rollback evidence.
